summary.name: AirBattery
summary.one_liner: AirBattery is a macOS app that shows the battery levels of your Apple devices and some Bluetooth peripherals in the Dock, menu bar, or widgets.
use_cases: Check iPhone, iPad, AirPods and Apple Watch battery from a Mac
See battery of Magic Keyboard or Magic Mouse at a glance
Monitor battery of other Macs on the same local network
Set low-battery alerts so devices get charged in time
Display multiple device batteries in a desktop widget
summary.what_it_does: AirBattery collects battery usage for multiple devices without installing a client app on them. It supports iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods and Magic-series devices, plus some third-party Bluetooth keyboards, mice and headphones. Its Nearcast feature shows the battery of other Macs you own on the same LAN and their peripherals. It offers several widgets, including one showing up to 8 devices and a dual-row battery widget. Users can set low-battery alerts for any device.
notable: No client app needed on monitored devices
Nearcast shows batteries of other Macs on the LAN
caveats: iPhone/iPad must be connected via USB once to trust the Mac for pairing
Older app versions may stop running because the developer's free certificate expired; users must install the latest version
